bbs_input_limitation: Pinned Football-Data CSVs contain shots but no timestamped BBS observations. The production BBS-priority rule runs unchanged; BBS therefore cannot activate on these pinned inputs.
benchmark_execution: rerun_exact_benchmark.py schedules unchanged historical_benchmark.evaluate_league calculations in five independent processes, then uses historical_benchmark.run to validate inputs, aggregate and reconcile the standard report. No forecast results are reused.

model_upgrade_comparison.note: Positive gain = lower error than the production v1 replay on identical fixtures. Asian handicap = home side; integer lines exclude refunded outcomes.
